summary.headline: Astrology of War and Tyranny
summary.text: Catalog entries for Vatican and Paris astrological codices covering planetary squares, diameters, hexagons, warfare, tyranny, ambassadorship, battle locations and timing, army size, and deceit or ambush, with manuscript folio references.
